chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
The best of deeds is that which you force yourself to do.
ai.seo_question: What is considered the best deed in Shia Islam according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) identifies the highest merit in deeds as those performed through conscious struggle against the soul's natural inclination toward ease, a concept deeply rooted in the Shia understanding of *Jihad al-Nafs* (struggle of the self). This teaching emphasizes that spiritual excellence is measured not by the absence of difficulty, but by the willful transcendence of one's base desires, reflecting the broader Islamic principle that true virtue requires effort.

en.sayed-ali-raza: 249. Amīr al-mu’minīn, peace be upon him, said:
The best act is that which you have to force yourself to do.
